topics.title: A simple miracle: committing to a better tomorrow
topics.starting_phrase: And then the רבי said, "Would you like to see me make a miracle?" So they said, "Yes." So the רבי said, "If everyone here, myself included, will commit that tomorrow will be better than today, that will be a great miracle."
